import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Make a copy of the dataframe to avoid modifying the original
    cleaned_df = df.copy()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, handling commas and invalid parsing
    cleaned_df['body_mass_g'] = cleaned_df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Remove rows with negative or out-of-range flipper_length_mm
    cleaned_df = cleaned_df[(cleaned_df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (cleaned_df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    # Standardize sex labels by stripping whitespace
    cleaned_df['sex'] = cleaned_df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    return cleaned_df

def answer(df):
    cleaned_df = clean(df)
    # Group by sex and calculate the average body mass
    avg_body_mass = cleaned_df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return avg_body_mass
